content.title: Go Blue Guarantee | University of Michigan-Dearborn
content.text: Skip to main content Previous Next Go Blue Guarantee Go Blue Guarantee Students at UM-Dearborn are eligible for the Go Blue Guarantee - University of Michigan’s landmark promise of free tuition for high-achieving in-state undergraduate students from qualifying backgrounds. Eligibility includes:Full-time, in-state undergraduate studentFamily income $125,000 or lessAssets below $125,000Incoming 3.5 GPA Go Blue Guarantee FAQ Request Information Additional Free Tuition Programs Many of our students are receiving scholarships and grants to cover their tuition beyond the Go Blue Guarantee. In Fact, in 2024 nearly half of our incoming first year students received scholarships and grants to cover 100% of their tuition. All other scholarships and grants have their own eligibility requirements. MAS PathwayRequirements:Full-time, in-state studentFamily income of $75,000Eligible for the Michigan Achievement Scholarship Detroit PromiseRequirements:Live in Detroit and graduate from a Detroit high schoolFull-time, in-state studentFirst year student eligibility requirementsTransfer student eligibility requirements Wolverine PathwaysRequirements:Full-time, in-state studentParticipate and graduate from the Wolverine Pathways program Reduced Tuition Many of our families with higher incomes and assets can still qualify for merit based scholarships at UM-Dearborn. We encourage you to complete the Net Price Calculator and explore more options for paying for college. Net Price Calculator Costs & Aid How to Qualify Apply Submit your application for admission to UM-Dearborn. Submit FAFSA Complete and submit your Free Application for Federal Student Aid. Get Admitted All admitted undergraduate students who file their FAFSA are considered for the Go Blue Guarantee and the Michigan Achievement Scholarship automatically.
